title: The rank of a finite projective module is locally constant on Spec
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M$ a finite projective $A$-module (e.g. a direct summand of a finite free $A$-module). Then for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset A$ the localization $M_{\mathfrak p}$ is a finite free $A_{\mathfrak p}$-module, and the function $\operatorname{Spec}A\to\mathbf N$, $\mathfrak p\mapsto\operatorname{rank}_{A_{\mathfrak p}}M_{\mathfrak p}$, is locally constant for the Zariski topology.
